versions.changelog:
Initial release of RunningHub skill.

- Provides integration with RunningHub cloud ComfyUI platform for AI workflows.
- Supports text-to-image, text-to-video, video synthesis, and face-swapping tasks.
- Allows workflow execution, status query, and management via API.
- Offers endpoints and platform versions for both China (runninghub.cn) and international (runninghub.ai) users.
- Includes instructions for obtaining API keys and example API usage.
